cards.example_en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
cards.example_zh: 你的绝妙主意为我们省下了好几个小时的工作。
cards.explain_zh: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

cards.example_en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
cards.example_zh: 你的绝妙主意为我们省下了好几个小时的工作。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our career adviser suggested a summer job at the library.
cards.example_zh: 职业顾问建议我暑假到图书馆去打工。

cards.example_en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
cards.example_zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花茎，再给花瓶加水。
cards.explain_zh: “源于”用stem from；大写STEM指理工科。

cards.example_en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
cards.example_zh: 许多城市交通问题源于规划不善，而不只是道路空间不足。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Investment in renewable energy could help reverse the recent rise in emissions from electricity generation.
cards.example_zh: 对可再生能源的投资可能有助于扭转近期发电排放量上升的趋势。
cards.explain_zh: 倒车用reverse；撤销决定可说reverse a decision。

cards.example_en: I switched my phone to silent mode before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前，我把手机调成了静音模式。
cards.explain_zh: 方式常用mode of；设备处于某模式用in ... mode。

cards.example_en: Cycling is an environmentally friendly mode of transport that can also improve public health in urban areas.
cards.example_zh: 骑行是一种环保的交通方式，也能改善城市居民的健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
cards.example_zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。
cards.explain_zh: 照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。

cards.example_en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
cards.example_zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。
cards.explain_zh: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

cards.example_en: Pose for a photo by the tree.
cards.example_zh: 在树旁摆个姿势拍照。

cards.example_en: You can adjust the height of the chair.
cards.example_zh: 你可以调节椅子的高度。

cards.example_en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
cards.example_zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。
cards.explain_zh: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

cards.example_en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
cards.example_zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Nowadays, I usually pay for groceries with my phone.
cards.example_zh: 如今，我买食品杂货通常用手机付款。
cards.explain_zh: 常与一般现在时连用，强调今昔对比；不用加介词。

cards.example_en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。
cards.explain_zh: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

cards.example_en: The museum displays agricultural tools used by local farmers.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了当地农民使用过的农具。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词，常修饰 land、production、machinery。

cards.example_en: Modern agricultural practices can increase food production, but excessive chemical use may damage soil and water quality.
cards.example_zh: 现代农业生产方式可以提高粮食产量，但过量使用化学品可能损害土壤和水质。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The new bakery is our biggest competitor for local customers.
cards.example_zh: 那家新面包店是我们争取本地顾客时最大的竞争对手。
cards.explain_zh: competitor指竞争者；competition指竞争或比赛。

cards.example_en: This restaurant serves fresh juice but does not sell alcohol.
cards.example_zh: 这家餐馆供应鲜榨果汁，但不卖酒。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。

cards.example_en: Public health campaigns should explain how excessive alcohol consumption can damage both physical and mental health.
cards.example_zh: 公共卫生宣传应解释过量饮酒如何损害身心健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。
cards.explain_zh: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

cards.example_en: I added one carrot, my favorite vegetable, to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 我往汤里加了一根胡萝卜，那是我最喜欢的蔬菜。
cards.explain_zh: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
cards.example_zh: 我们把箱子装进了一辆白色的小型厢式货车。
cards.explain_zh: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。

cards.example_en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
cards.example_zh: 经过几周练习，我站在台上时感到很自信。
cards.explain_zh: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

cards.example_en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
cards.example_zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。
cards.explain_zh: planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。

cards.example_en: The driver slowed down as we approached a sharp curve.
cards.example_zh: 我们接近一个急弯时，司机放慢了车速。
cards.explain_zh: curve可作名词或动词；“弯曲的”用curved。

cards.example_en: The driver slowed down as we approached a sharp curve.
cards.example_zh: 我们接近一个急弯时，司机放慢了车速。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
cards.example_zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。
cards.explain_zh: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

cards.example_en: She managed to overcome her fear of speaking in class.
cards.example_zh: 她设法克服了在课堂上发言的恐惧。

cards.example_en: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
cards.example_zh: 我在网上找到了一份简单的汤谱。
cards.explain_zh: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

cards.example_en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
cards.example_zh: 跳进泳池前先确认水深。
cards.explain_zh: in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。

cards.example_en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。
cards.explain_zh: 某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

cards.example_en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
cards.example_zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐在湖边一段倒下的树干上。
cards.explain_zh: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。

cards.example_en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们坐在湖边一段倒下的树干上。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
cards.example_zh: 一个巨大的南瓜几乎占满了整辆园艺推车。
cards.explain_zh: 作形容词通常放名词前；作名词可指行业巨头。

cards.example_en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
cards.example_zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都会感谢上帝。
cards.explain_zh: 指唯一的神用God，通常不加冠词；泛指神用god。

cards.example_en: A large portion of our garden is shaded.
cards.example_zh: 我们花园里有很大一部分处于阴凉处。
cards.explain_zh: portion可指整体的一部分，也常指一人份食物。

cards.example_en: A large portion of our garden is shaded.
cards.example_zh: 我们花园里有很大一部分处于阴凉处。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A sticky substance had leaked onto the kitchen floor.
cards.example_zh: 一种黏糊糊的物质漏到了厨房地板上。
cards.explain_zh: 表示物质种类时可数；表示实质或根据时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Factories must prevent harmful substances from entering rivers, as contaminated water threatens both wildlife and human health.
cards.example_zh: 工厂必须防止有害物质进入河流，因为受污染的水会威胁野生动物和人类健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The storm caused extensive damage to our roof.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨使我们家的屋顶大面积受损。
cards.explain_zh: 强调范围广或数量多；intensive强调集中、强度高。

cards.example_en: Extensive research is needed before governments introduce major changes to the national education system.
cards.example_zh: 政府对国家教育制度进行重大改革之前，需要开展广泛研究。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Researchers must interpret survey results carefully because cultural differences may influence how participants understand the questions.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员必须谨慎解读调查结果，因为文化差异可能影响参与者对问题的理解。
cards.explain_zh: interpret可指口译；笔译通常用translate。

cards.example_en: Learning to cook gave him a sense of independence.
cards.example_zh: 学会做饭让他有了自立的感觉。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；independence from表示不依赖或不受控制。

cards.example_en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
cards.example_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

cards.example_en: The inner pocket of my coat held the bus ticket.
cards.example_zh: 我外套里面的口袋装着公交票。

cards.example_en: Too much sunlight can harm the leaves of this plant.
cards.example_zh: 阳光过强会损伤这种植物的叶子。
cards.explain_zh: 名词不可数；用do harm to，动词harm直接接宾语。

word.example_en: I switched my phone to silent mode before dinner.
word.example_zh: 晚饭前，我把手机调成了静音模式。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Untreated waste can pose a threat to river ecosystems.
word.example_zh: 未经处理的废物可能对河流生态系统构成威胁。

word.example_en: Roads that curve around existing woodland can reduce habitat destruction, although they may increase construction costs.
word.example_zh: 绕着现有林地修建的弯曲道路可以减少栖息地破坏，但可能增加建设成本。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Housing costs consume a substantial portion of household income, particularly in cities with limited affordable accommodation.
word.example_zh: 住房开支占家庭收入的很大一部分，在平价住房有限的城市尤其如此。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The storm caused extensive damage to our roof.
word.example_zh: 暴风雨使我们家的屋顶大面积受损。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
